purpose: bounded non-reset audit after user confirmed OLED IDLE and HX OK

events.state_basis: user confirmed OLED IDLE after unloaded HX:OK CAL_USER

dcb_after_open.meaning: Windows DCB after SerialPort opened and configured as requested; not a readback of the pre-open DCB or device firmware

modem_status.meaning: Host-observed input modem status, not sensor or firmware health

limitations: DCB describes settings after this process configured and opened port; it does not prove prior DCB, UART connectivity or absence of device errors.
No device commands were sent. No RX bytes does not locate root cause.
No manual DTR/RTS transitions, reset, queue discard, or ClearCommError were issued.
